Decimal is preferable for currency because it can represent base-10 values like 0.01 exactly, avoiding the tiny rounding errors that binary floating point introduces for many decimal fractions. Those rounding errors can accumulate across additions, subtractions, taxes, and discounts, causing cents to be lost or gained unexpectedly.
